long_description: This cross-border safari is the pinnacle of East African wildlife experiences. Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, cross the vast Serengeti plains, and finish in Kenya's legendary Masai Mara. Six days of non-stop wildlife encounters across two countries.

Serengeti endless plains
Cross-border Tanzania to Kenya
Big Five in multiple parks

title: 8 Days Masai Mara, Lake Nakuru & Diani Beach Safari from Nairobi | Mid Range Road and Train Tour
destination: Lake Nakuru, Masai Mara, Diani Beach
description: An 8 day mid range Kenya safari that combines Lake Nakuru and the Masai Mara with three relaxing days at Diani Beach, with full board meals, a private 4x4 Land Cruiser, train tickets between Nairobi and Mombasa and all park fees.
long_description: This 8 day mid range safari takes you from the Great Rift Valley to the Masai Mara and finishes with a relaxed stay on the Indian Ocean coast at Diani Beach. You begin with a scenic drive from Nairobi, with stops at the Rift Valley viewpoint and the little Italian church, before an afternoon game drive at Lake Nakuru National Park. The park is known as a bird sanctuary because flamingos can cover the whole surface of the lake, and it is the only park in Kenya where you are sure to see both white and black rhinos. From Nakuru you drive to the Masai Mara National Reserve for three nights at Zebra Plains Mara Camp, with an afternoon game drive on arrival and two full days of game viewing, including a picnic lunch near the Mara River. The Mara is one of the few places where you can see all of the Big Five, and between July and October the plains fill with migrating wildebeest and zebras. On day five you return to Nairobi and take the afternoon train to Mombasa, where you are picked up and taken to Baobab Beach Resort in Diani for three nights on full board. You can swim, take a boat ride, watch birds, learn about Swahili culture or arrange a short fishing trip with local guides. On the last day you leave the resort to catch the afternoon train back to Nairobi. Game drives are in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser with a professional driver guide, and all park fees, train tickets and transfers are included.
highlights: Afternoon game drive at Lake Nakuru National Park with flamingos and both white and black rhinos
Three nights in the Masai Mara with two full days of game drives
Chance to see the Great Migration in season, usually between July and October
Comfortable train ride between Nairobi and Mombasa
Three nights on full board at Baobab Beach Resort in Diani
Private 4x4 Land Cruiser with a professional driver guide

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.description: Be picked up at your Nairobi hotel at 8 am and drive south along the Great Rift Valley, stopping at the viewpoint to admire the escarpment. A few minutes further on you will stop at the little Italian church, which was built by Italian workers during the construction of the road as a place to worship. You reach Nakuru in time for lunch at Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge, followed by an afternoon game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park. The park is known as a bird sanctuary because the surface of the lake can be covered by lesser and greater flamingos. It is also famous for the Big Five without elephants, and it is the only park in Kenya where you are sure to see both white and black rhinos. Return to the lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at the lodge, then say goodbye to Nakuru and drive to the Masai Mara. You will be welcomed with lunch at the camp when you arrive, and after a short rest you head into the reserve for an afternoon game drive. The Mara is one of the few places left on earth where wildlife still lives in great numbers, much as it did when it roamed the plains and forests of Africa. As the northern tip of the vast Serengeti ecosystem, it hosts the spectacular seasonal migration of many thousands of wildebeest, zebras and the predators that follow them. Drive back to the camp in the evening for dinner and overnight at Zebra Plains Mara Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring the Masai Mara in depth. A packed lunch is served picnic style inside the park, close to the Mara River. The reserve is well known for its black maned lions and its resident wildlife, and it is one of the few places where you may see the Big Five during a single morning game drive. Many cheetahs here are so used to vehicles that they rest in the shade under them, and some even climb onto the roof for a better view of their prey. Return to the camp in the evening for dinner and overnight at Zebra Plains Mara Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave at 6:30 am for a game drive that lasts until 6:30 pm, looking for wildlife you did not see the day before. Because nature cannot be predicted, you will cover different parts of the reserve and gain new experiences. The Masai Mara is the most famous reserve in Kenya because of its large wildlife population, and it is one of the few places where all of the Big Five are found. The park is also home to about 470 bird species and rare animals such as roan antelopes and nocturnal bat eared foxes, and you will see the lilac breasted roller, which is the national bird of Kenya. Return to the camp in the evening for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi and Diani Beach
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back to Nairobi and be dropped off at the railway station to catch the 3 pm train to Mombasa. On arrival in Mombasa you will be picked up and taken to Baobab Beach Resort or a similar resort in Diani for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Relax at Diani Beach
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at the resort, then enjoy a day at the coast, which is home to the Swahili people of Kenya and rich in cultural heritage. Lunch is served at the resort, and you can spend the rest of the day on beach activities such as swimming, boat rides and bird watching, depending on what you have planned. Dinner and overnight are at the resort on a full board basis.

itinerary.title: Beach Day at Diani
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast in the comfort of your resort and carry on with the beach activities that the front office desk can arrange for you. You can take photos, or ask about short fishing trips along the coast for both beginners and experienced fishermen, which are arranged at a small fee agreed with the local guides. All meals and the overnight stay are at the resort.

itinerary.title: Diani Beach to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Wake up relaxed and have breakfast at your leisure. Then leave the resort to connect to the 3 pm train from Mombasa back to Nairobi, taking home the best memories to share with friends. This ends your safari.

title: 8-Day Kenya & Tanzania Combined Safari
description: The ultimate East Africa safari combining Kenya and Tanzania's finest parks in one unforgettable 8-day journey.
long_description: This comprehensive 8-day safari is the definitive East African experience. Start at Lake Nakuru, continue to the Masai Mara, cross into Tanzania for the Serengeti, descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, and finish at Lake Manyara. Eight days of extraordinary wildlife encounters spanning two countries and five iconic destinations.
highlights: Five iconic wildlife destinations
Cross-border Kenya-Tanzania experience
Ngorongoro Crater descent
Serengeti and Masai Mara in one trip

title: 4 Days Masai Mara Safari from Nairobi | Enchoro Wildlife Camp
description: A private 4 day Masai Mara safari with three nights at Enchoro Wildlife Camp, daily game drives, full board meals, and road transfers from Nairobi.
long_description: This 4 day safari takes you from Nairobi to the Masai Mara National Reserve, one of the finest wildlife destinations in Africa. The reserve is home to more than 450 recorded animal species and, between July and September, the great herds of migrating wildebeest and zebra. You will spend three nights at Enchoro Wildlife Camp on a full board basis and enjoy daily game drives in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser with a professional driver guide. The pace is relaxed and flexible, so you can choose full day game drives or split the day into separate drives with time for short excursions nearby. A hot air balloon flight over the Mara plains can be arranged locally at an extra cost. On the final day you drive back to Nairobi with lunch on the way and are dropped at your city hotel or at JKIA airport depending on your flight time.

Daily game drives in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi by road in the morning and travel across the Rift Valley towards the Masai Mara. Arrive at Enchoro Wildlife Camp in time for lunch, then meet your driver guide at 2 pm for your first game drive in the reserve. Enjoy dinner and spend the night at the camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave the camp for a full day of game drives across the reserve, exploring areas with high concentrations of wildlife. The Masai Mara is home to more than 450 recorded species, and between July and September the plains fill with migrating wildebeest and zebra. Lunch is served in the park, after which you return to Enchoro Wildlife Camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara Game Drives
itinerary.description: Another day dedicated to wildlife viewing. You may choose a full day of game drives or separate drives with time in between for short excursions nearby. Your driver guide will gladly plan the day around your preferences. This is also the perfect opportunity to add a hot air balloon flight over the Mara plains, which can be arranged at an extra cost before booking.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the camp, then say goodbye to the Masai Mara as you drive back to Nairobi with lunch on the way. On arrival you will be dropped at your city hotel or at JKIA airport depending on your flight timings.

title: 5-Day Nakuru, Naivasha & Masai Mara Safari
destination: Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha, Masai Mara
description: Explore the flamingo-lined shores of Lake Nakuru, the scenic Lake Naivasha, and the wildlife-rich Masai Mara in one incredible journey.
long_description: This 5-day safari combines three of Kenya's most stunning destinations. Start with the famous Lake Nakuru, known for its flamingos and rhino sanctuary. Continue to the scenic Lake Naivasha for a boat ride and optional cycling tour, before heading to the world-renowned Masai Mara for unforgettable game drives.
highlights: Lake Nakuru flamingos and rhinos
Boat ride on Lake Naivasha
Big Five game viewing in Masai Mara
Great Rift Valley views

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi and drive to Lake Nakuru. Afternoon game drive around the lake, spotting flamingos, rhinos, and other wildlife.

title: 9 Days Ol Pejeta, Lake Nakuru, Masai Mara, Lake Naivasha & Amboseli Safari from Nairobi | Mid Range Private Tour
destination: Ol Pejeta, Lake Nakuru, Masai Mara, Lake Naivasha, Amboseli
description: A 9 day mid range private safari that covers five of the best wildlife areas in Kenya: Ol Pejeta Conservancy, Lake Nakuru, the Masai Mara, Lake Naivasha and Amboseli, with a private 4x4 Land Cruiser, meals as in the itinerary and all park fees.
long_description: This 9 day safari is a complete tour of Kenya, taking you from the plains of Laikipia to the slopes of Mount Kilimanjaro. You start with a scenic drive north to Ol Pejeta Conservancy, a wildlife sanctuary where you can see lions, elephants, buffaloes, giraffes and rhinos on an afternoon game drive. Next comes Lake Nakuru National Park, a haven for birds and rhinos where thousands of flamingos can turn the shoreline pink. You then spend three nights in the Masai Mara, one of the best places in Africa to see big game, with game drives every day and a full day exploring the plains and the Mara River. Between July and September the grasslands are covered with wildebeest, zebras and gazelles during the great migration. From the Mara you travel to Lake Naivasha for a boat safari among hippos and fish eagles and a walk on Crescent Island, where you can stroll among zebras, giraffes and antelopes with no predators around. The safari ends with two nights in Amboseli, where large herds of elephants walk against the backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro, and you can climb Observation Hill for a view over the swamps and plains. Transport is in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser with a professional driver guide, and you are dropped off at your preferred location in Nairobi at the end.
highlights: Big Five game viewing in Ol Pejeta Conservancy including rhinos
Flamingos, white and black rhinos and Rothschild giraffes at Lake Nakuru
Three nights in the Masai Mara with game drives every day
Boat safari on Lake Naivasha and a walk among wildlife on Crescent Island
Elephants against Mount Kilimanjaro and Observation Hill views in Amboseli

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Ol Pejeta Conservancy
itinerary.description: Leave Nairobi in the morning and head north towards Ol Pejeta Conservancy, a renowned wildlife sanctuary in Laikipia. Enjoy the scenic views of central Kenya on the way, and arrive at your camp in time for lunch. In the afternoon, set out on an exciting game drive, where you have the chance to see lions, elephants, buffaloes, giraffes and rhinos in their natural habitat. Return to the camp for dinner and overnight at Sweetwaters Serena Camp.

itinerary.title: Ol Pejeta Conservancy to Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave Ol Pejeta and travel to Lake Nakuru National Park, a haven for birds and rhinos. Arrive in time for lunch, then head out in the afternoon on a game drive around the lake, where thousands of flamingos can turn the shoreline pink. Keep an eye out for white and black rhinos, Rothschild giraffes and the elusive leopard. As the sun sets, return for dinner and a restful night at Eagle Palace Hotel.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.description: Leave for the Masai Mara in the morning and check in at your camp on arrival for lunch. After a little rest, enjoy an afternoon of wildlife viewing in the reserve, which has an abundance of wildlife and big game. The spectacular wildebeest migration takes place from July to September, when the grasslands are covered with a mass of wildebeest, zebras and gazelles, and large predators arrive to take advantage of the prey. Return to the camp in the evening for dinner and overnight at Enchoro Wildlife Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.description: Have an early breakfast and head out for a game drive in the legendary Masai Mara. The reserve is home to an abundance of wildlife, including lions, cheetahs, elephants, buffaloes and zebras. Return to the camp for lunch, then set out again for an afternoon game drive. After an exhilarating day, return to the camp for dinner and overnight at Enchoro Wildlife Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Spend the whole day exploring the vast plains of the Masai Mara on game drives. With a packed lunch, venture deep into the reserve in search of the Big Five and other iconic animals. Visit the Mara River, where crocodiles and hippos thrive and, if you are lucky, you may witness dramatic predator and prey encounters. Return to the camp in the evening for a well earned dinner and overnight rest.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: After breakfast, say goodbye to the Masai Mara and travel to Lake Naivasha, arriving in time for lunch. Spend the afternoon exploring this peaceful lake. One of the highlights is a boat safari, where you can get close to hippos, fish eagles and other bird species. Crescent Island offers the chance to walk among grazing zebras, giraffes and antelopes in an environment with no predators. Enjoy the evening at your lodge, soaking in the calm atmosphere of the lake, with dinner and overnight at Dove Nest Lodge.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Amboseli National Park
itinerary.description: Have an early breakfast before leaving for Amboseli National Park, which lies at the foot of the majestic Mount Kilimanjaro. Arrive in time for lunch at your camp, then head out on an afternoon game drive. Amboseli is best known for its large herds of elephants, often seen against the backdrop of the highest mountain in Africa. Return to the camp in the evening, where you can relax and enjoy stunning sunset views of Kilimanjaro. Dinner and overnight at Nyati Safari Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Amboseli National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend a full day in Amboseli with morning and afternoon game drives. Capture breathtaking views of elephants walking against the backdrop of Kilimanjaro, one of the most iconic sights in Africa. Visit Observation Hill for a panoramic view of the park and its varied landscapes, including the swamps where hippos and water birds thrive. Dinner and overnight at Nyati Safari Camp.

itinerary.title: Amboseli National Park to Nairobi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, begin your journey back to Nairobi, where you will be dropped off at your preferred location. This marks the end of an extraordinary 9 day Kenya safari, and you head home with endless sweet memories.

long_description: This group joining safari is the most affordable way to experience the legendary Masai Mara. You will share a safari vehicle with other like-minded travelers, keeping costs low while still enjoying world-class game drives and comfortable accommodation.

title: 3 Days Masai Mara Group Joining Safari from Nairobi | Enchoro Wildlife Camp
description: Join a small group on a 3 day Masai Mara safari with two nights at Enchoro Wildlife Camp, a full day of game drives, and shared transport in a 4x4 Land Cruiser.
long_description: This 3 day group joining safari is a fun and affordable way to experience the Masai Mara National Reserve. You will travel from Nairobi in a shared 4x4 Land Cruiser with a professional driver guide and a small group of fellow travelers, and spend two nights at Enchoro Wildlife Camp on a full board basis. After arriving on day one, you head straight out for an evening game drive when the animals emerge from their hides to feed. Day two is a full day in the reserve in search of the Big Five, with a picnic lunch served along the banks of the Mara River, the famous crossing point of the great migration. In the evening you can add an optional visit to a Maasai village to learn about their culture and traditions. On the final morning you enjoy breakfast at the camp before driving back to Nairobi, where you will be dropped at your city hotel or at JKIA airport depending on your flight timings. The reserve records more than 450 bird species, and whether you are a wildlife lover or a birding enthusiast, the Masai Mara rarely disappoints.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Set off from your hotel or residence in Nairobi at 7:30 am, heading down into the Great Rift Valley with a quick stop to enjoy the view from the escarpment. Another stop in Narok town gives you the chance to pick up any personal items you may need during the safari, as the driver also refuels the vehicle in this last major town. You will arrive at the Masai Mara in good time for lunch at the camp, leaving you free to relax after the long drive. After lunch and a brief rest, head out for an evening game drive when the wildlife comes out to feed. Dinner and overnight at Enchoro Wildlife Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at 6 am and leave the camp with a packed picnic lunch at 6:30 am. Spend the entire day exploring the reserve in search of the Big Five. With more than 450 bird species recorded here, there is much to see, including rhinos, leopards, elephants, buffalo, wildebeest, zebras, warthogs, jackals, lions, many types of antelopes, crocodiles and giraffes, whether you are a game lover or a birding enthusiast. Picnic lunch is served in the reserve along the banks of the Mara River, the wildebeest migration crossing point. In the evening you can add an optional visit to a Maasai village to learn more about their cultural practices, then drive back to camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast prepared at the camp, then say goodbye to the Masai Mara as you drive back to Nairobi. On arrival you will be dropped off at your city hotel or at JKIA airport depending on your flight timings. End of safari.

title: 6 Days Ngorongoro, Serengeti & Masai Mara Mid Range Safari from Nairobi | Angata & Sopa Lodges
description: A private 6 day mid range safari from Nairobi through Ngorongoro Crater, the Serengeti and the Masai Mara, staying at Angata and Sopa lodges, with full board meals, park fees and a private 4x4 Land Cruiser.
long_description: This 6 day safari takes you across the border from Kenya into Tanzania and back again, visiting three of the most famous wildlife areas in Africa. You start in Nairobi and are driven to the Namanga border, where your guide meets you and takes you to the Ngorongoro Crater, a huge natural bowl packed with wildlife. From there you travel to the Serengeti, whose name means endless plains in the Maasai language, and spend a full day exploring its grasslands, home to lions, leopards, cheetahs and vast herds of plains game. You then cross back into Kenya through Isebania and finish with a full day in the Masai Mara, where you may see the Great Migration depending on the season. You stay in comfortable mid range camps and lodges, with meals, park fees and drinking water all included. Transport is in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser with a professional English speaking driver guide, and the safari ends with a scenic drive back to Nairobi.
highlights: A full day on the floor of Ngorongoro Crater
A full day exploring the Serengeti plains
Cross border safari between Tanzania and Kenya

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: You are picked up from your hotel in Nairobi at 5 am and driven to the Namanga border, where your guide meets you. From there you drive to Ngorongoro Crater for a day of game viewing on the crater floor. You stop for a picnic lunch at the Ngoitoktok Springs picnic site. All of the Big Five may be seen here, along with cheetahs, Grants and Thomsons gazelles, zebras, wildebeest and spotted hyenas, and flamingos are sometimes seen on the crater lake. Dinner and overnight at Angata Ngorongoro Camp in the Nyati area.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater to Serengeti National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave Ngorongoro and drive across the beautiful Ngorongoro highlands before descending into the vast Serengeti plains. The Serengeti is famous for its endless grasslands and its huge numbers of wildlife. You enjoy game drives as you enter the park, where you may spot elephants, giraffes and possibly a leopard. You arrive at your camp in the late afternoon, relax for a while, then go out on an evening game drive. Dinner and overnight at Angata Serengeti Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Serengeti
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the whole day exploring the Serengeti plains on game drives. This UNESCO World Heritage Site is home to the Big Five and a great variety of other wildlife. The central plains are a good place to find leopards, hyenas and cheetahs. The park is also the main stage for the yearly migration of wildebeest and zebras between the Serengeti and the Masai Mara. Eagles, flamingos, ducks, geese and vultures are among the birds you may see. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the bush before exploring other parts of the park, then return to your camp in the evening for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, leave the camp for a last game drive on your way out of the Serengeti. You drive to Isebania for immigration formalities, with a packed lunch along the way. As you enter the Masai Mara you enjoy more game viewing across its rolling savannahs, which are known for their wildlife and dramatic encounters between predators and prey. You arrive at your lodge in the evening for dinner and overnight at Masai Mara Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the full day on game drives across the rich grasslands and rolling hills of the Masai Mara, Kenya's most celebrated safari destination. The Mara is known for its great herds of plains game, black maned lions, leopards and cheetahs, as well as many elephants and almost every kind of wildlife found in Kenya. Depending on the season, you may witness the Great Migration, when millions of wildebeest and zebras cross the Mara River in search of fresh grazing. Enjoy a picnic lunch by the river or under an acacia tree before an afternoon game drive, then return to your lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave the Masai Mara and drive back to Nairobi. Enjoy the scenic drive across the Rift Valley, with lunch on the way, and arrive in Nairobi in the late afternoon with happy memories of your safari. End of safari.

title: 7-Day Luxury Masai Mara & Amboseli Experience
description: The ultimate luxury Kenya safari with premium lodges, private game drives, and exclusive experiences in the Mara and Amboseli.
long_description: Indulge in the finest safari experience Kenya has to offer. Stay at premium lodges and tented camps, enjoy private game drives in custom 4x4 Land Cruisers, and experience exclusive bush dinners, sundowners, and cultural encounters. This is safari at its most refined.
highlights: Premium luxury lodges throughout
Private 4x4 game drives
Exclusive bush dinner under the stars
Hot air balloon safari included

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: VIP transfer to Masai Mara. Check into luxury lodge. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Hot Air Balloon Safari
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn balloon flight over the Mara. Champagne bush breakfast. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Private game drives. Evening bush dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara Conservancy
itinerary.description: Game drives in private conservancy. Walking safari with Masai guides.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Amboseli
itinerary.description: Scenic transfer to Amboseli. Afternoon game drive with Kilimanjaro views.

itinerary.title: Full Day Amboseli
itinerary.description: Morning and afternoon game drives. Sundowner drinks with Kilimanjaro backdrop.

itinerary.title: Amboseli to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Final sunrise game drive then VIP transfer to Nairobi.

title: 3-Day Amboseli National Park Safari
description: Witness the majestic Mount Kilimanjaro as a backdrop while observing large elephant herds in their natural habitat at Amboseli.
long_description: Amboseli National Park is renowned for its large elephant herds and stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro. This 3-day safari provides intimate encounters with elephants and over 400 bird species, all set against one of the most photographed backdrops in Africa.
highlights: Mount Kilimanjaro views
Large elephant herds
Over 400 bird species
Observation hill panoramic views
included: Return transport from Nairobi in 4x4 Land Cruiser

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.description: Drive from Nairobi to Amboseli with stunning views of Kilimanjaro. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Amboseli
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Amboseli with morning and afternoon game drives. Visit Observation Hill for panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Amboseli to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Sunrise game drive for a final wildlife encounter, then return to Nairobi.

title: 5-Day Amboseli, Tsavo West & Tsavo East Drop-off Mombasa
description: Journey from Amboseli through the red earth of Tsavo to the coast, combining safari with beach possibilities in Mombasa.
long_description: This 5-day safari takes you from the elephant paradise of Amboseli through the hilly landscapes of Tsavo West, visiting Mzima Springs, and into the vast Tsavo East before dropping you at Mombasa for an optional beach extension. Perfect for those who want safari and beach in one trip.
highlights: Mzima Springs underwater viewing
Red elephants of Tsavo
Mount Kilimanjaro views
Drop-off at Mombasa for beach option

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.description: Drive to Amboseli with views of Kilimanjaro. Afternoon game drive among elephant herds.

itinerary.title: Amboseli to Tsavo West
itinerary.description: Transfer to Tsavo West. Visit Mzima Springs and enjoy an afternoon game drive in the hilly terrain.

itinerary.title: Full Day Tsavo West
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Tsavo West, including Shetani lava flows and more wildlife viewing.

itinerary.title: Tsavo West to Tsavo East
itinerary.description: Cross into Tsavo East, famous for its red elephants. Afternoon game drive along the Galana River.

itinerary.title: Tsavo East to Mombasa
itinerary.description: Morning game drive, then transfer to Mombasa arriving by late afternoon.

title: 3-Day Masai Mara National Reserve Road Safari Tour
description: Experience the Masai Mara in 3 days: Big Five, 450+ animal species and the Great Wildebeest Migration (Jul–Sep).
long_description: Discover the best highlights of Kenya's Masai Mara National Reserve in just 3 days and 2 nights. Spot the park's 450+ animal species — from migrating zebras and wildebeests (Jul–Sep) to the Big Five. Includes comfortable tented accommodation or lodge, meals, park fees and round-trip transfers from Nairobi.
highlights: Big Five game viewing
Great Wildebeest Migration opportunity (Jul–Sep)
Multiple game drives
Round-trip transfers from Nairobi

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi at 7:30 AM via the Great Rift Valley escarpment viewpoint and Narok town. Arrive for lunch then afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Day Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Full day of game drives. Morning drive to spot predators, packed picnic lunch at the Mara River, then afternoon drive.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Early morning game drive then depart for Nairobi arriving late afternoon.

title: 4 Days Masai Mara Group Joining Safari from Nairobi | Enchoro Wildlife Camp
description: Join a group of fellow travelers on a 4 day Masai Mara safari with three nights at Enchoro Wildlife Camp, two full days of game drives, and road transfers from Nairobi.
long_description: This 4 day group joining safari is made for travelers who want the full Masai Mara experience at a shared cost. You will be picked up from your Nairobi hotel in the morning and travel with a small group in a customized safari van with a pop up roof, driving along the Great Rift Valley with a stop at a viewpoint for photos and a chance to meet local artisans. Three nights are spent at Enchoro Wildlife Camp, giving you extra time in the reserve compared to a shorter safari. You will enjoy an afternoon game drive on arrival day, a full day exploring the savannah with a picnic lunch, and another full day from early morning to sunset covering different parts of the reserve in search of wildlife you may have missed. The Masai Mara is Kenya's most famous reserve, one of the few places where all of the Big Five can be found, with 470 bird species and rare animals such as roan antelopes and bat eared foxes. On the final day, after an early breakfast, you drive back to Nairobi for your drop off, concluding the safari with sweet memories to carry home.
highlights: Group joining safari with shared transport and costs
Three nights at Enchoro Wildlife Camp
Afternoon game drive on arrival day
Two full days of game drives in the reserve
Big Five and 470 bird species recorded
Optional visit to a Maasai village
included: All meals as per the itinerary
All transport in a customized safari van with a pop up roof
Game drives as per the itinerary
excluded: Drinks such as alcohol and beers

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Be picked up at your hotel by 8 am by your safari tour guide and meet the rest of the group. Transfer to the Masai Mara on a drive of five to six hours, passing along the Great Rift Valley with scenic views and a short stop at a viewpoint for photos. You will also interact with the locals and get a chance to buy some beautiful and unique handmade pieces. Arrive in time for lunch after checking in at the camp. In the afternoon, go out for a game drive in search of animals such as lions, wildebeest, cape buffalo, gazelles, leopards, African elephants and cheetahs, among others. In the evening, head back to your camp for dinner and overnight at Enchoro Wildlife Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast at the lodge, depart for a full day game drive in the Masai Mara National Reserve, carrying packed picnic lunch boxes. Explore the savannah in the morning in search of lions, cheetahs, elephants, buffalo and giraffes, while herds of wildebeest, zebras and gazelles graze in the golden morning light. Drive across the open plains and visit areas around the Talek or Mara Rivers to see hippos and crocodiles. Enjoy a picnic lunch served at a scenic spot inside the reserve, often under an acacia tree or near the riverbank, then continue deeper into the reserve as elephants cool off, buffalo gather in herds and predators prepare for their evening hunts. Conclude the day with a slow game drive back to camp, capturing sunset scenes across the savannah. An optional cultural visit to a Maasai village can be arranged at extra cost. Dinner and overnight at Enchoro Wildlife Camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave for an early game drive from 6:30 am to 6:30 pm in search of wildlife you never got a chance to view the previous day. You will cover different parts of the reserve, because nature is unpredictable and every day brings new experiences. The Masai Mara is Kenya's most famous reserve thanks to its large populations of wildlife, and it is one of the few places where all of the Big Five can be found. The park also boasts 470 bird species and rare animals such as roan antelopes and nocturnal bat eared foxes, along with the beautiful lilac breasted roller, Kenya's national bird. Return to the camp in the evening for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast at your camp, check out and depart the Masai Mara for Nairobi. Arrive in Nairobi and be dropped off at your hotel or the airport. This concludes your safari, with sweet memories to carry home.

title: 3 Days Amboseli Safari from Nairobi to Diani Beach | Nyati Safari Camp
description: A 3 day Amboseli safari with two nights at Nyati Safari Camp, daily game drives with Mount Kilimanjaro views, and a beach drop off in Diani at the end.
long_description: This 3 day safari combines the best of bush and beach. Starting from Nairobi, you travel to Amboseli National Park, famous as one of the best places in the world to get close to free ranging elephants, with the majestic Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest peak, as a dramatic backdrop. You will spend two nights at Nyati Safari Camp Amboseli and enjoy daily game drives across the open savannah, where lions, giraffes, zebras and all members of the Big Five can be seen throughout the year. The park also records more than 470 bird species, many of them raptors. After a final morning in the park, the journey continues south with lunch on the way and ends with a drop off at your beach hotel in Diani, leaving you with memories to last a lifetime.
highlights: Close encounters with free ranging elephants
Stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro
All members of the Big Five seen year round
Early morning and afternoon game drives
More than 470 recorded bird species
Drop off at your beach hotel in Diani
included: Services of a professional driver guide
Pick up in Nairobi and drop off in Diani
Game drives as per the itinerary
Transport in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser
Accommodation at Nyati Safari Camp Amboseli

Optional hot air balloon safari at 450 USD per person

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli National Park
itinerary.description: You will be picked up from your hotel in Nairobi early in the morning at 8 am and depart for Amboseli National Park, arriving in time for a relaxed lunch at Nyati Safari Camp. In the afternoon, head out for your first game drive. This is the final catch of the day for many animals, which come out of their hides to feed and bask in the sun, while kobs and other grazers gather before their night's rest. Amboseli is famous as the best place in the world to get close to free ranging elephants, and the park enjoys wonderful views of Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest free standing mountain in the world. Return to the camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Amboseli National Park
itinerary.description: Set out early for a morning game drive to catch the African sunrise, when the animals are most active and fresh as they search for food in the open savannah grassland. Continue with a full day of game viewing with a packed picnic lunch. As the day warms up, many animals gather near the river banks to drink and cool down, while the big cats are rarely spotted until the sun goes down. Amboseli is home to all members of the Big Five, found here all year round, and more than 470 bird species have been recorded, around 60 of them raptors. Dinner and overnight at Nyati Safari Camp.

itinerary.title: Amboseli National Park to Diani
itinerary.description: Wake up early, enjoy breakfast at the camp, and leave for Diani at 9 am. You will have lunch along the way, after which you will be dropped off at your hotel in Diani with lots of good memories. End of safari.

title: 6 Days Masai Mara, Lake Nakuru & Lake Naivasha Safari | Hot Air Balloon Included
destination: Masai Mara, Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha
description: A private 6 day Kenya road safari combining the Masai Mara, Lake Nakuru and Lake Naivasha, with a hot air balloon flight, full board meals and transport in a 4x4 Land Cruiser.
long_description: This 6 day road safari is a classic Kenyan journey through three of the country's most rewarding destinations. It begins with two nights in the Masai Mara National Reserve, where you go in search of the Big Five across plains that host more than 450 recorded animal species and, between July and September, the great herds of the migration. A highlight of the trip is a hot air balloon flight over the Mara at sunrise, followed by a champagne style breakfast in the bush and a certificate from your captain. From the Mara the safari continues to Lake Nakuru National Park, a rhino sanctuary famous for its flamingos, pelicans and rich birdlife. You then travel to the fresh waters of Lake Naivasha for a night before a final day at Hell's Gate National Park, one of the few parks in Kenya where you can walk or cycle among zebra, buffalo and antelope. The safari ends with a drive back to Nairobi arriving in the late afternoon. Transport throughout is in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser with an English speaking driver guide.
highlights: Two nights in the Masai Mara with daily game drives
Hot air balloon safari over the Mara with bush breakfast
Flamingos, rhinos and birdlife at Lake Nakuru
Hell's Gate National Park where you can walk or cycle among wildlife
Private 4x4 Land Cruiser with English speaking driver guide
Optional Crescent Island walking safari on Lake Naivasha

itinerary.title: Nairobi City Visit
itinerary.description: Before the safari begins, enjoy a visit to the Sheldrick Wildlife Trust Nairobi Nursery, where orphaned elephants and rhinos are cared for, followed by a stop at the Giraffe Centre. These visits are included in the package and can be arranged on the day before departure.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.description: Set off from your Nairobi hotel at 7:30 am, heading down into the Great Rift Valley with a quick stop to admire the view from the escarpment. A second stop in Narok town allows you to pick up any personal items you may need, as this is the last major town before the reserve. Arrive at the Masai Mara in good time for lunch at the camp, then head out in the afternoon for your first game drive in search of the Big Five. Return to camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the full day on game drives across the reserve, which is home to an amazing concentration of wildlife and more than 450 recorded species. Between July and September the Mara plains fill with migrating wildebeest and zebra, while resident wildlife can be seen all year round. Lunch is served in the park near the Mara River, the famous crossing point during the migration. Return to camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara Hot Air Balloon Safari
itinerary.description: Wake very early for a transfer to the balloon launch site and lift off for an approximately one hour flight over the Mara plains. On landing, enjoy a champagne style picnic breakfast in the bush and receive your flight certificate from the captain. Rejoin your driver guide for a full day game drive to spot wildlife you may have missed, or return to camp for lunch and spend the afternoon on an optional guided visit to a Maasai village or a nature walk with Maasai guides. Dinner and overnight at the camp.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave the camp and drive to Lake Nakuru National Park with lunch served on the way. The lake offers the chance to see hundreds of bird species, including lesser and greater flamingos and pelicans, and the park is also a rhino sanctuary. Waterbuck, impala, buffalo and gazelle are often seen in the surrounding bush. Dinner and overnight at a hotel in Nakuru town.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for an extensive morning game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park, famous for the flocks of flamingos and other water birds that gather along its shores. Leave Nakuru after a late lunch and drive to Lake Naivasha for dinner and overnight at a hotel by the lake.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Nairobi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit Hell's Gate National Park, known for its dramatic landscapes, towering cliffs, gorges, geothermal features, hot springs and steam vents. It is one of the few parks in Kenya where visitors can walk or cycle among wildlife, and you may spot zebra, buffalo, antelope and rare birds such as vultures and eagles. You can also climb Fischer's Tower or relax at the nearby Olkaria Geothermal Spa. An optional boat ride on Lake Naivasha or a walking safari on Crescent Island, where giraffe, zebra and waterbuck roam freely, can be arranged before you leave for Nairobi with lunch on the way, arriving in the late afternoon as the safari ends.

title: 5 Days Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha & Masai Mara Mid Range Safari
destination: Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha, Masai Mara
description: A 5 day mid range safari combining Lake Nakuru, Hell's Gate and Lake Naivasha with two nights in the Masai Mara, staying at Sopa lodges and Zebra Plains Mara Camp.
long_description: This 5 day safari blends three of Kenya's most loved destinations with comfortable mid range accommodation throughout. The journey begins at Lake Nakuru National Park, a bird sanctuary where the alkaline lake is often ringed with lesser and greater flamingos, and the only park in Kenya where you are assured of seeing both white and black rhinos. From Nakuru you continue to Lake Naivasha for a visit to Hell's Gate National Park, where dramatic cliffs, geothermal springs and the striking Hell's Gate Gorge can be explored on foot, by bicycle or through rock climbing, and wildlife such as zebras and giraffes roams free of large predators. You then drive through Narok town to the Masai Mara National Reserve for two nights at Zebra Plains Mara Camp, with an afternoon game drive on arrival, a full day in the reserve with a picnic lunch at the Mara River, and a final optional visit to a Maasai village before returning to Nairobi. Between July and October the Mara plains host the great migration as wildebeest and zebras cross over from the Serengeti. Transport is in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser with a professional driver guide throughout.

Hell's Gate National Park explored on foot or by bicycle
Two nights in the Masai Mara at Zebra Plains Mara Camp
Full day game drive with picnic lunch at the Mara River
Great Migration crossings between July and October
Comfortable mid range lodges throughout

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi at 7:30 am and drive southwards via the Rift Valley viewpoint, where you will admire the escarpment. Just a few meters ahead, stop at the little Italian church, which was built by Italian prisoners during the construction of the road so that they could worship. Arrive in Nakuru in time for lunch, then head out for an afternoon game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park, a bird sanctuary where the entire surface of the lake can be covered by lesser and greater flamingos. The park is also famous for the Big Five excluding elephants, and it is the only park in Kenya where you are assured of seeing both the white and the black rhinos. Return to the lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave your lodge for the short drive to Lake Naivasha and visit Hell's Gate National Park, renowned for its dramatic landscapes, towering cliffs, geothermal springs and the striking Hell's Gate Gorge. Unlike most national parks, it offers a more interactive experience where you can explore on foot, by bicycle or through rock climbing, and it is home to zebras, giraffes and various bird species, though it lacks large predators. An optional boat ride on Lake Naivasha can be arranged. Dinner and overnight at your lodge or resort by the lake.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive via Narok town to the Masai Mara National Reserve, arriving in time for lunch at your camp. In the afternoon, proceed for a game drive exploring the reserve in search of the Big Five. With more than 450 bird species recorded here, there is much to see, including rhinos, leopards, elephants, buffalo, wildebeest, zebras, warthogs, jackals, lions, many types of antelopes, crocodiles and giraffes, whether you are a game lover or a birding enthusiast. Return to your camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave the camp for a whole day game drive in the park, where you will enjoy and admire the great wildlife that inhabits this unique reserve. The zebras and wildebeest migrate from the Serengeti in Tanzania to Kenya and back again, and this migration takes place from July to October each year. Have your picnic lunch at the Mara River as you admire the fantastic wildlife, with several other animals also present, such as lions, giraffes, antelopes, gazelles and oryx. Return to your tented camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you have the option of visiting a Maasai village, where you will learn about the pristine culture of the Maasai tribe. Afterwards, drive back to Nairobi and be dropped off at JKIA airport or your preferred drop off point within the city.

title: 6 Days Masai Mara Migration Safari with Lake Nakuru & Lake Naivasha
destination: Masai Mara, Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha
description: A 6 day private migration safari with four nights in the Masai Mara at Zebra Plains Mara Camp, a night at Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge, and a boat ride on Lake Naivasha before returning to Nairobi.
long_description: This 6 day safari is built around the great wildebeest migration, giving you more time in the Masai Mara than a standard itinerary. After an early departure from Nairobi through the Great Rift Valley, you spend four nights at Zebra Plains Mara Camp or a similar camp, with an afternoon game drive on arrival followed by three full days in the reserve from early morning to sunset. Long days in the Mara mean a real chance of witnessing the migration crossings at the Mara River between July and October, and the reserve is one of the few places where all of the Big Five can be found, alongside 470 bird species and rare animals such as roan antelopes and bat eared foxes. The safari then continues to Lake Nakuru National Park, a rhino sanctuary where the alkaline lake attracts hundreds of bird species including flamingos and pelicans, for a night at Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge or similar. The final day is spent at Lake Naivasha, where a boat ride brings you close to hippos, before driving back to Nairobi. Throughout, you have exclusive use of a 4x4 safari Land Cruiser with a pop up roof, an English speaking driver guide, and a radio to help locate wildlife.
highlights: Four nights in the Masai Mara timed for the Great Migration
Three full days of game drives from sunrise to sunset
Mara River crossing point visited during migration season
Rhinos and flamingos at Lake Nakuru National Park
Boat ride among hippos on Lake Naivasha
Exclusive use of a 4x4 Land Cruiser with a pop up roof

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.description: Set off from your hotel or residence in Nairobi at 8 am, heading down into the Great Rift Valley with a quick stop to admire the view of the escarpment. Another stop in Narok town allows you to pick up any personal valuables you might need, as the driver also refuels the vehicle in this last town. Arrive at the Masai Mara in good time for lunch at the camp, giving you a chance to relax after the lengthy drive. Following lunch, you can choose from the various activities available at the camp, including a guided nature walk, a Masai village visit, or an afternoon game drive in the park to see the Big Five, all of which live in this wonderful game reserve. Dinner and overnight at Zebra Plains Mara Camp or similar.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at 6 am and leave the camp with a packed picnic lunch at 6:30 am for a full day of game drives from 6:30 am to 6:30 pm. Spend the entire day exploring the reserve in search of the Big Five. With more than 450 bird species recorded here, there is much to see, including rhinos, leopards, elephants, buffalo, wildebeest, zebras, warthogs, jackals, lions, many types of antelopes, crocodiles and giraffes, whether you are a game lover or a birding enthusiast. Picnic lunch is served in the reserve along the banks of the Mara River, the wildebeest migration crossing point. Return to the camp in the evening for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave for an early game drive from 6:30 am to 6:30 pm in search of wildlife you never got a chance to view the previous day, and gain more experiences, because you cannot predict nature and you will be covering different parts of the reserve. The Masai Mara is Kenya's most famous reserve due to its large population of wildlife, and it is one of the few places where all of the Big Five are found. The park also boasts 470 species of birds and rare animals like roan antelopes and nocturnal bat eared foxes, and you will also see the beautiful lilac breasted roller, which is Kenya's national bird. Back to the camp in the evening for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Another full day in the reserve from 6:30 am to 6:30 pm, exploring fresh corners of the Mara that you have not yet visited. Each area of the reserve offers something different, from open plains where big cats roam to the riverine forest along the Mara River where hippos and crocodiles gather. Your driver guide uses the vehicle's radio to follow sightings across the park, giving you the best possible chance of witnessing a migration crossing when the herds are in season. Dinner and overnight at Zebra Plains Mara Camp or similar.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave the camp and depart for Lake Nakuru National Park, arriving in the mid morning with a lunch break at your lodge, followed by a safari game drive. Lake Nakuru gives you a chance of viewing hundreds of species of birds, including the lesser and greater flamingos and the pelicans. It is also a rhino sanctuary, and waterbucks, impala, buffalo and gazelle are found in the surrounding gardens. Dinner and overnight at Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge or similar.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Lake Naivasha and Nairobi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave your lodge for a drive to Lake Naivasha, located in Kenya's Rift Valley and renowned for its dramatic landscapes. You will arrive in good time to explore Lake Naivasha on a boat ride tour, watching hippos in the water and birds along the shore through the entire afternoon. Leave for the drive back to Nairobi with sweet memories as your safari ends.
